Assistant (0.6s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Ms Schmidt?

User (2.3s): Yes, this is Hannah Schmidt.

Assistant (3.2s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (4.2s): Twenty-eighth of April.

Assistant (5.3s): Thank you. And the year?

User (7.4s): Nineteen ninety-three.

Assistant (8.9s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (10.2s): thirty-three.

Assistant (10.9s): Thank you. And the remaining 2 digits?

User (12.1s): seventeen.

Assistant (16.6s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your credit card ending 5512 has a past-due amount of 180.00, which is 5 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (18.2s): I already paid it in the app this morning.

Assistant (21.8s): Payments can take one business day to appear. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
